title: Chapter 64 Historical Truth, Revenge
content:
Chapter 64 Historical Truth, Revenge

In the long river of time and space.

Lu Daosheng looked at Yang Jiusheng who left in a hurry, shook his head and smiled, and then went forward.

He wanted to see what happened to the human race in that blank period of history.

According to An Xing's report, a long time ago, the human race seemed to have an extremely glorious history.

Later, the human race suddenly disappeared.

There was no record of the cause of this incident in the Wanling Realm, not even a trace.

With curiosity, Lu Daosheng directly looked through the long river of time and space.

I saw that when Lu Daosheng touched the long river of time and space, the entire long river of time and space trembled.

Fear.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Don't worry, as long as you behave yourself, I won't hurt you."

Soon, the scene that Lu Daosheng wanted to see was also presented in front of him.

I saw that the Wanling Realm at that time was countless times more glorious than it is now.

There were even more powerful people in the heavenly realm.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng was silent.

How could this be so similar to the beginning in the Hongmeng Universe?

Could it be that the Wanling Realm also encountered a powerful enemy?

Then Lu Daosheng jumped directly to the time period when the human race had an accident.

At this time, the human race was in its most glorious period in history.

The three major forces of the human race jointly ruled the entire Wanling Realm, reaching a prosperous period when all races came to pay tribute.

And one of the forces was the Heavenly Court.

The other two were the Human Emperor Palace and the Holy Gate.

Lu Daosheng thought of Ye Qing, who was still kneeling in front of the gate of the deserted city.

The other party claimed to be a general of the Heavenly Court, no wonder he was so arrogant. The Heavenly Court at its peak did have this ability to be arrogant.

Thirty-six generals of the Heavenly Court, the Lord of the Heavenly Court even reached a realm above the realm of destiny, and his strength was unfathomable.

The other two human forces, the Human Emperor Palace and the Holy Gate, were almost as powerful as the Heavenly Court.

Why did such a powerful human race suddenly disappear in the Wanling Realm?

As time passed, the answer was soon known.

In an ancient hall, three powerful men with terrifying auras sat opposite each other. At this moment, their eyes were full of solemnity and unwillingness.

"Is there really no way?"

"They won't give us a chance."

These three people are the master of the Human Emperor Palace, the master of the Holy Gate, and the master of the Heavenly Court.

At this time, the master of the Heavenly Court stood up.

"It is impossible to escape, and it is even more impossible to beg for mercy. In this case, my Heavenly Court will fight with the other party to the end!"

Hearing this, the other two leaders of the forces looked at each other and nodded firmly.

There is no spineless human race.

"Then fight!"

That day, a huge space-time crack suddenly appeared above the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

Countless creatures with terrifying auras and far more powerful than the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm continued to pour out from it.

That day, the entire Ten Thousand Spirits Realm was shaken.

That battle, blood flowed like a river.

That catastrophe was destined.

In the end, the human race was destroyed, and the three major forces were almost wiped out. Only a small number of survivors remained alive, but they also lost hope for the future.

Among them was Ye Qing.

After that, the Wanling Realm also fell into a long period of silence, and civilization almost broke down.

A long, long time later, many races that survived the war gradually recovered some vitality and began to reappear in the Wanling Realm.

Although they were far less powerful than they were back then, the basic races still existed.

However, the human race will never come back.

Because there is no one in the Wanling Realm who can carry the entire human race.

In front of the Long River of Time and Space, Lu Daosheng was silent for a long time.

It was like this again.

From the records of the Long River of Time and Space, Lu Daosheng learned the identity of the other party.

Jiemeng.

Lu Daosheng didn't know anything about this force.

But he knew that this would definitely be his enemy and that was it.

The other party destroyed the human race at its most glorious period, so it would definitely attack his own deserted city. It was probably just a matter of time.

And the purpose of the other party's attack seemed to be because the human race was unwilling to submit to the other party.

Just because of this, he attacked the entire Wanling World.

This move was a great evil.

Then, Lu Daosheng left the long river of time and space and returned to the city lord's mansion.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and Ye Qing, who was far outside the gate of the deserted city, suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Seeing Lu Daosheng, Ye Qing was stunned, and then respectfully said: "Ye Qing, meet the senior!"

This time, he was no longer as arrogant as the first time, but put his status very low.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Ye Qing and knew why the other party had not protected the human race in these years.

Because after that battle, the surviving Ye Qing had lost all his fighting spirit, and finally locked himself in a ruin in the heaven, unwilling to face all this again.

As for revenge, Ye Qing didn't even think about it.

Because the human race was already so powerful back then, but they were still destroyed by the other side.

The Lord of Heaven, who had always been invincible in his heart, also died in that catastrophe.

He thought he would live the rest of his life in vain, but he didn't expect that he would meet Lu Daosheng.

When the two of them communicated through the air for the first time, Ye Qing only had a little interest in Lu Daosheng.

The second time Ye Qing came to the deserted city, looking at such a prosperous deserted city, Ye Qing was also a little surprised, but he had guessed that Lu Daosheng's strength was definitely not as good as his.

After all, to become a general of the heavenly court, it is not as simple as reaching the destiny realm.

So he wanted to let Lu Daosheng know his strength, and also to remind Lu Daosheng not to be so high-profile in the world of all spirits, otherwise, it is very likely to usher in a catastrophe.

Just like the human race back then.

And it was not until Lu Daosheng took action that all this ended.

It turned out that everything was just his clown-like fantasy.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said: "What's the matter with you coming back to see me?"

Hearing this, Ye Qing knelt on the ground and said in a deep voice: "I want to join the predecessor's deserted city and revitalize the human race!"

Lu Daosheng looked at Ye Qing, "Revenge?"

Hearing these two words, Ye Qing couldn't help but tremble all over.

Gritting his teeth, Ye Qing used all his strength and finally said firmly: "Revenge!"

After speaking, Ye Qing immediately collapsed on the ground.

After countless years, this is the first time Ye Qing said the word revenge.

At this time, Ye Qing did not notice that his strength began to change.

Stronger.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng smiled.

"I can give you a chance for revenge, but determination is not as simple as words."

Hearing this, Ye Qing was relieved.

As long as he can be given a chance.

If there is still a chance to avenge the Heavenly Court and the human race in this life, he will die without regrets.

At this time, Lu Daosheng said: "Heavenly Court, it is impossible that only you are alive?"

Hearing this, Ye Qing's face trembled, "Senior, what do you mean?"

Lu Daosheng said lightly: "Go find them all, I will help you improve your strength."

"Wait until the World Alliance arrives, you can take revenge."

Hearing this, Ye Qing nodded decisively, and then said: "Then senior, I'll go."

However, Ye Qing just stood up and fell down again, and his consciousness began to gradually blur.

The injury was too severe, and he has not recovered yet.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng held his forehead, then waved his hand, and a stream of pure energy directly restored Ye Qing.

Feeling the vitality overflowing in his body, Ye Qing quickly stood up, his face embarrassed.

"Thank you, senior."

Then Ye Qing quickly stood up and left the deserted city.

In the Heavenly Court, it was indeed not only him who survived, but also the Human Emperor Palace and the Holy Gate.

But over the years, there was almost no communication between them, and some people had even died.

Ye Qing had no way of knowing whether they still had the will to fight.

So, the matter that Lu Daosheng had entrusted was not easy.

But in order to avenge the Heavenly Court and the human race, even if he resisted, he had to carry those former comrades to Lu Daosheng.

He believed that when those comrades saw Lu Daosheng, they would definitely rekindle their faith like him.

Because this terrifying strong man is also a human!
